sign_in.subject: Sign in to {app}
sign_in.heading: Sign in to {app}
sign_in.body: Use this to sign in. It works once and expires soon.
sign_in.closing: If you did not ask to sign in, you can ignore this email.

registration.subject: Confirm your {app} account
registration.heading: Welcome to {app}
registration.body: Confirm this address to finish creating your account.
registration.closing: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

already_registered.subject: You already have a {app} account
already_registered.heading: You already have an account
already_registered.body: Someone asked to register this address, but it already has an account. Use this to sign in to it instead.
already_registered.closing: If this was not you, you can ignore this email. Nothing has changed.

email_change.subject: Confirm your new email address
email_change.heading: Confirm your new email address
email_change.body: Confirm this address to make it the one your {app} account signs in with.
email_change.closing: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

email_change_approval.subject: Approve your {app} email change
email_change_approval.heading: Approve the email change
email_change_approval.body: Someone signed in to your account asked to move it to another email address. Approve it while signed in to go ahead.
email_change_approval.closing: If this was not you, do not approve it. Sign in and change your password, and sign out of your other sessions.

email_changed.subject: Your {app} email address changed
email_changed.heading: Your email address changed
email_changed.body: Your account now signs in with a different email address, and this one can no longer be used to recover it.
email_changed.closing: If you did not do this, contact support straight away.

password_changed.subject: Your {app} password changed
password_changed.heading: Your password changed
password_changed.body: The password for your account was just changed.
password_changed.closing: If you did not do this, sign in with a link sent by email and set a new password.

token_prompt: Paste this token where you were asked for it:

mfa.subject: Your {app} verification code
mfa.heading: Your verification code
mfa.body: Enter this code to finish signing in:
mfa.closing: If you are not signing in, someone has your password: change it.
